row.team_price_text: Business: $20 per seat / month (JetBrains Central; paid plans not yet sold during EAP)
row.evidence: JetBrains Central Console's plan table lists 'IdP and SCIM configuration' only for Enterprise and marks it '* Coming soon' (features planned but not yet released).
row.notes: JetBrains organizations (IDE licences, AI credits) are now managed in JetBrains Central Console, which replaced JetBrains Account org management for commercial licences. SCIM is not offered today: the plans page lists 'IdP and SCIM configuration' as an Enterprise-only feature that is 'Coming soon'. When it ships it will be Enterprise (On request), i.e. gated. Plans: Basic free, Business $20 per seat/month (during EAP everyone is on Basic), Enterprise on request. Users are added and removed manually in the Console or through the JetBrains Account REST API (invite/create account, delete account, assign/revoke licences; verified domain required; personal X-Api-Key tokens that never expire). Okta's 'JetBrains' OIN app is SWA only. The separate self-hosted JetBrains IDE Services product pulls users and groups from Okta or Entra ID via their APIs (vendor-run directory sync), not SCIM. IDE licence prices (All Products Pack etc.) were not used for team_plan.
